findings.current: “Show your face and reveal your identity! How dare you ambush me! Do you not fear the Lord of Heaven?”
findings.defect: Great Sir reverses what one reveals and what one removes; the draft turns his mistake into an ordinary demand and breaks Bow Saint’s correction.
findings.rationale: He says to reveal the mask and remove the identity, prompting Bow Saint to correct the latter phrase.
findings.replacement: “Reveal your mask and take off your identity! How dare you ambush me! Do you not fear the Lord of Heaven?”
findings.source: 복면을 밝히고 정체를 벗어라! 감히 본녀(本女)를 기습하다니, 천주 신명이 두렵지 않느냐!

findings.current: “You should take off your face, not reveal it.”
findings.defect: Bow Saint corrects which thing he should take off, not whether to reveal his face.
findings.rationale: The correction is explicit and is followed by the observation that he is not wearing a mask.
findings.replacement: “You take off the mask, not your identity.”

findings.current: “About half a shichen ago, I finished scouting the whole area like I was told and went back to the carriage. But before I could even sit down, I got kicked right back out.”
findings.defect: Half a shichen is about an hour; 한 식경 is about half an hour.
findings.rationale: The draft doubles the elapsed time by substituting a different unit.
findings.replacement: “About half an hour ago, I finished scouting the whole area like I was told and went back to the carriage. But before I could even sit down, I got kicked right back out.”
findings.source: 한 식경 전쯤인가, 시킨 대로 근방을 싹 돌아보고 마차로 돌아갔다가 엉덩이도 못 붙여 보고 다시 내쫓겼소.

findings.current: More precisely, the stench that had arrived before them, barging in like a thief.
findings.defect: The draft drops the explicit description of the stench as horrendous at the moment she recognizes it.
findings.rationale: 무시무시한 qualifies the smell, and the guest is subsequently identified as a man.
findings.replacement: More precisely, the horrendous stench that had arrived before him, barging in like a thief.
findings.source: 정확히는, 그보다 먼저 도적처럼 들이닥친 무시무시한 악취가.

findings.current: But before she could finish, Great Sir leaned in and whispered conspiratorially.
findings.defect: Leaning in is an added physical action.
findings.rationale: The source specifies his manner of speaking but does not say he moves closer.
findings.replacement: But before she could finish, Great Sir whispered conspiratorially.
findings.source: 하지만 궁성의 말이 채 끝맺어지기도 전에, 대인이 은근한 목소리로 속삭였다.

findings.current: “That fellow Jin Taekyung was looking for you, too. He looked full of energy after sleeping for a whole month.”
findings.defect: Great Sir’s uncertainty about whether anything has happened is omitted.
findings.rationale: 뭔 일이 있긴 한 건지 introduces his speculation before he mentions Taekyung.
findings.replacement: “I wonder if something’s happened—Jin Taekyung was looking for you, too. He looked full of energy after sleeping for a whole month.”
findings.source: 뭔 일이 있긴 한 건지, 진태경 그 친구도 여협을 찾더라고요.

summary: The draft loses the mask-and-identity reversal, changes a time interval, and adds or omits several smaller details.
